verified: 2026-10-28 — curated from the official Marketo Engage REST error-codes page. Descriptions are the official wording; 'comment' is the docs' clarification. Unknown codes fall back to the HTTP status + Marketo's raw message.

401.comment: Usually an invalid Client ID or Client Secret (identity endpoint). Re-test the connection.

403.comment: Your API user doesn't have permission for this call — check the call's 'Permission' label.

404.comment: Marketo couldn't find that record — the ID or name may be wrong, or it was deleted.

413.comment: The request body exceeds Marketo's size limit (1 MB standard, 10 MB bulk).

414.comment: The request URL was too long (8 KB max). Use fewer fields/IDs, or split the request.

502.comment: The server hit an unexpected condition. Retry in a moment.

503.comment: Marketo is temporarily unavailable. Wait and retry.

600.comment: Marketo had a server error. Retry in a moment.

601.comment: The access token sent was not valid. The app refreshes it automatically; if it persists, re-test the connection.

602.comment: The access token expired. The app refreshes it automatically; if it persists, re-test the connection.

606.comment: More than 100 calls in the past 20 seconds. Wait a moment and try again.

607.comment: Today's calls exceeded the subscription quota (resets daily at 12:00 AM CST).

609.comment: The request body is not valid JSON.

610.comment: The URI did not match a REST resource type — often a misspelled or malformed URL.

611.comment: Marketo system error. Retry in a moment.

613.comment: The multipart content was not formatted correctly.

614.comment: The destination subscription can't be found or is unreachable — usually temporary.

615.comment: Too many calls running at once on this instance. Wait a few seconds and retry.

701.comment: A required field was empty in the request.

714.desc: Unable to find the default record type

1001.comment: A parameter value has a type mismatch (e.g. a string where an integer is required).

1002.comment: A required parameter is missing from the request.

1003.comment: The submitted data isn't valid for this endpoint/mode. NOTE: Marketo also returns 1003 when a filter matches too many leads — narrow the filter or use a Bulk Extract.

1004.comment: For Sync Leads with action=updateOnly, the lead was not found.

1005.comment: For Sync Leads with action=createOnly, the lead already exists.

1006.comment: A field in the call is not a valid field for this object.

1007.comment: Multiple leads match the lookup criteria — updates need a single match.

1008.comment: The user can't access the workspace/partition where the record exists.

1011.comment: A lookup/filter field is not supported (e.g. firstName/lastName as filterType).

1012.comment: Invalid Munchkin/cookie value (Associate Lead, or filterType=cookies).

1013.comment: Get object (list, campaign) by id returned not found.

1015.comment: The lead is not a member of the target list.

1016.comment: Too many imports queued — a maximum of 10 is allowed.

1017.comment: Creation failed because the record already exists.

1018.comment: The instance has a native CRM integration enabled, blocking this action.

1019.comment: The target list is already being imported to.

1020.comment: Reached the daily allotted use of cloneToProgramName for Schedule Program.

1021.comment: Company update not allowed during Sync Leads.

1026.comment: Custom objects integration is not enabled on this instance.

1027.comment: Reached the maximum number of custom activity types.

1028.comment: Custom activities have a maximum of 20 secondary attributes.

1036.comment: Two or more records used the same foreign key (e.g. the same externalCompanyId).

1037.comment: The lead is already in or past this status.

1042.comment: The Schedule Campaign runAt date is too far in the future (max 2 years).

1048.comment: Failed to discard the draft version of a custom object.

1049.comment: The attributes array exceeded the 65,536-byte max length.

1076.comment: Merge Leads (mergeInCRM) would create a duplicate — use an existing record instead.

1077.comment: Merge failed — a Salesforce field exceeds its limit. Reduce it or set mergeInCRM=false.

1078.comment: Merge failed — deleted entity, not a lead/contact, or filter criteria doesn't match.

1079.comment: Many leads share the same Personalized URL — merge via the Marketo UI instead.
